body:
I think this line of code should be relevant: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/09fcbb86459498985a910cdd1684844a1968dc96/editor/editor_file_system.cpp#L1406
 
I suspect this line always fails in my system, hence the change detection is thwarted. For some reason, in ExFAT drives, mac does not update modified time of the parent directory if any of its descendant item is updated; only the item itself get updated. I tried to run `stat <godot project dir>` and it will always report that `st_mtime == st_ctime`, and because I think `modified_time` is sourced from this, this `current_mtime != p_dir->modified_time` check will always be `false`

Regarding the second check, it appears that it uses `get_filesystem_type`, which i guess the implementation on macos should be these lines: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/09fcbb86459498985a910cdd1684844a1968dc96/drivers/unix/dir_access_unix.cpp#L518-L520 and it looks like it's still marked as todo.
